description: "Be first, be smarter or cheat!" The pay-to-play Palm Beach County 2009 scandals resulted in Grand Jury reports and Court demands Yet, the unpretentious, free-spirited sister of Palm Beach island was still stared at for years, West Palm Beach was always vulnerable. Long time residents and Voters protected her strong, authentic beauty, knowing she will grow
